presets.name: Stage silent
presets.desc: Mutes the output while engaged and names each plucked string in tens of ms against the lane's tuning
presets.notes: The pedal tuner between songs. golem sends the lane's tuning (Custom + strings) at insert; Fast settles in 0.2 – 0.8 s

presets.name: Stage silent, bass
presets.desc: Mutes the output while engaged and reads each bass string, the low B included, against the lane's tuning
presets.notes: Low strings take longer: the coarse note in 80 ms, the strobe reading from 0.45 s on a low B

presets.name: Strum check
presets.desc: Strum all the open strings at once: one column per string, the strings that share a partial dimmed
presets.notes: Neck pickup and a thumb strum keep the upper partials low; pluck a dimmed string alone to read it exactly

presets.name: Strobe setup
presets.desc: Chromatic strobe at ±0.1 ¢ with an honest settled flag, heard while tuning: intonation at the bench
presets.notes: Compare the open string with the 12th fret fretted, not the harmonic (sharp by the string's inharmonicity)

presets.name: Five-string low B
presets.desc: Reads a 5-string bass from its low B: long window down to 25 Hz, the strings prior against octave errors
presets.notes: Fast settles a clean low B in about 0.75 s; switch to Strobe for a final check (1 s, 2 s on a hard pluck)

presets.name: Drop A seven
presets.desc: Seven-string drop A (A1 E2 A2 D3 G3 B3 E4): the low A on the long window, each pluck on its string
presets.notes: A1 is 55 Hz: the long YIN window answers in about 80 ms

presets.name: Eight-string standard
presets.desc: Eight-string standard from the low F#: strings attributed by the tuning, strum read per string
presets.notes: On a strum the 8-string needs 0.85 s for its low strings: their neighbours are close in hertz

presets.name: Capo on 2
presets.desc: Standard tuning with every target two semitones up, for a capo on the 2nd fret
presets.notes: transpose shifts the string targets, not the reference

presets.name: Half step down
presets.desc: Every string a semitone down (Eb Ab Db Gb Bb Eb), each pluck attributed to its string
presets.notes: Same targets as 6-std with transpose −1; golem names them with flats

presets.name: Harmonic tuning
presets.desc: Tune with 12th-fret harmonics: each one is attributed to its own string, its offset included
presets.notes: A harmonic reads about 0.5 ¢ sharp of the open string's fundamental (inharmonicity); not corrected

presets.name: Reference A 432
presets.desc: Chromatic tuner with A4 at 432 Hz instead of 440: every note's target 31.8 ¢ lower
presets.notes: reference is normally one golem-wide setting; this preset sets it for this block only

presets.name: Baroque A 415
presets.desc: Chromatic strobe at A4 = 415 Hz, the usual baroque pitch, heard while tuning
presets.notes: 415 Hz is a semitone under 440 within 1 ¢

presets.name: Drift watch
presets.desc: Put away but still measuring: never mutes, keeps publishing the pitch for golem's drift badge
presets.notes: Long sets and changing temperature: the strings drift while playing, golem shows a small sharp / flat mark

presets.name: Voice practice
presets.desc: Chromatic reading with note hysteresis for a voice or a violin: a bend keeps its note until 60 ¢
presets.notes: The coarse stage reads up to about 1.5 kHz (F6); above, no reading
